item.title: 'Fingers on the trigger': Deadly warnings for Iranians being urged to take action
item.summary: Iran's police chief has warned that his forces would treat anyone taking to the streets "at the enemy's request" as an enemy.

item.title: Nineteen jailed over deadly Moscow concert attack
item.summary: Gunmen opened fire at Crocus City Concert hall near Moscow in 2024, killing 149 and injuring more than 500.

item.title: Countries agree to record release of emergency oil reserves as prices surge
item.summary: The G7 group of nations welcomes the idea of releasing oil in response to the surge in prices since the US-Israel war with Iran began

item.title: Questions mount for Hegseth over possible US involvement in strike on Iranian school
item.summary: Democrats have written to ask the defence secretary whether the US was responsible, but he says the issue is being investigated.

item.title: How Iran war laid bare the world's reliance on Gulf oil and gas
item.summary: Countries around the world are feeling the impact of the conflict and the resulting energy price shock.

item.title: War in Ukraine spills into Hungarian election campaign
item.summary: Hungary is going to the polls soon and Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has one public enemy in his sights - Ukraine's president.

item.title: Death toll from Ethiopia floods and landslides rises to more than 60
item.summary: Forecasters say storms are becoming more intense in the region, partly due to global warming.

item.title: Senegal approves tougher anti-gay law as rights groups raise concerns
item.summary: "Violence and fear" will spike and "equality and non-discrimination" will be trampled on, warn critics.

item.title: No evidence Swiss bus fire was terrorism, officials say
item.summary: Initial reports suggest a man with "psychological problems" set himself on fire on the bus, according to police.

item.title: China approves 'ethnic unity' law requiring minorities to learn Mandarin
item.summary: The law states that children should be taught Mandarin before kindergarten, until the end of high school.
